signal: Prove launched its unified Identity Platform in April 2026 as a trust layer for people, businesses, and AI agents, building on its Verified Agent solution.

email.body1:
Mike, saw Prove launched the unified Identity Platform as a trust layer for people, businesses, and AI agents.

Unifying the portfolio like that usually means more in-market accounts globally than your team can personally touch before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mike, quick follow-up for Prove.

With the Identity Platform live, global pipeline targets usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Prove needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mike, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to other identity and fraud software companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mike, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling global pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while the Identity Platform ramps, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a launch, and I know that stretch keeps a global sales team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your global motion? I'll tailor it to Prove either way.
